item.title: American stealth drone linked to Venezuela operation
item.description: A highly classified U.S. stealth surveillance drone has been tentatively linked to recent American military activity connected to events in Venezuela, although no official confirmation has been provided by Washington. Open-source imagery and video circulating in recent days appear to show a Lockheed Martin RQ-170 Sentinel operating in the wider Caribbean region, with some analysts […] The post American stealth drone linked to Venezuela operation first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK plans £64.5m mid-life upgrade for Titan and Trojan
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has published a transparency notice outlining plans to award a contract for the mid-life update of the British Army’s Titan and Trojan armoured engineer vehicles. The post UK plans £64.5m mid-life upgrade for Titan and Trojan first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Dstl awards follow-on contract for autonomous vessel support
item.description: The Defence Science and Technology Laboratory has awarded a follow-on contract to L3 Harris ASV to provide storage, maintenance and repair services for a fleet of government-owned surface vessels. The post Dstl awards follow-on contract for autonomous vessel support first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British troops land ‘in force’ in Arctic region
item.description: Royal Marines are deploying to northern Norway "in force" as the United Kingdom and Norway expand their military cooperation in the High North, according to the Royal Navy. The post British troops land ‘in force’ in Arctic region first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: HII’s ROMULUS unmanned vessel reaches 30% build mark
item.description: HII has confirmed that construction of the prototype for its new ROMULUS family of unmanned surface vessels has reached around 30 per cent completion, with the programme remaining on track for sea trials in late 2026 The post HII’s ROMULUS unmanned vessel reaches 30% build mark first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK plans new support contract for Protector weapon station
item.description: The Ministry of Defence is preparing a new support contract for the M151 Protector Remote Weapon Station, with Defence Equipment and Support publishing an advance pipeline notice. The post UK plans new support contract for Protector weapon station first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK expects 75th F-35 delivery by end of 2033
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the United Kingdom expects to have taken delivery of its 75th F-35 Lightning aircraft by the end of 2033. The post UK expects 75th F-35 delivery by end of 2033 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Update on plan for floating drydocks for British submarines
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that design work is already underway on new floating dry docks for the Royal Navy under Programme Euston, with a manufacturing contract to follow. The post Update on plan for floating drydocks for British submarines first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy starts 2026 with seven frigates
item.description: The Royal Navy is operating seven frigates as 2026 begins, highlighting continued strain on the surface escort fleet as it transitions away from the Type 23. The post Royal Navy starts 2026 with seven frigates first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Special Forces to seize tanker near Europe
item.description: According to reports from CBS, U.S. forces are planning to seize the tanker Marinera, formerly known as Bella 1, rather than sink it. The post U.S. Special Forces to seize tanker near Europe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
